scope: EXPLORATORY, requested after inspecting final-test results; not a frozen confirmatory hypothesis test

bootstrap.intervals: Pointwise paired-query percentile95; no multiplicity correction or new confirmatory decision
bootstrap.cost_matching: Recompute preselection probability from paired resampled costs; also recompute original cheap-control mixture weights from costs only. Saved random-IC20-seed schedules remain conditional/fixed.
bootstrap.randomness: Integrate model-choice coin analytically. Intervals quantify question-sampling uncertainty in expected outcomes, not a realized randomized run.

formula.rule: Choose strong with query-independent probability p before generation; otherwise choose small. Exactly one model call; no small call, probe or IC on the strong branch.

frontier.expanded_observed_frontier: Entire preselection line segment p in [0,1], including small-only and strong-only endpoints; all previously reported cascade/control points are weakly below/right of it.

limitations: Single 512-question test cohort, inspected before this analysis; no new prospective claim or deployment policy selection
Warm cached component times, not a live preselection benchmark; unmeasured dispatch/RNG, residency, loading, queuing and communication overhead excluded
Small-only component time retains the original feature-capture overhead; no new faster small-only inference was assumed
Expected randomized accuracy/cost differ from one realized schedule; original random-IC intervals conditional on saved schedules
Pointwise intervals over many comparisons do not establish simultaneous statistical dominance
Observed frontier relative to compared families; does not bound all possible query-dependent routers or generalize to other models/tasks
